item_short_desc: Rothco's Ramster Survival Knife is an indispensable tool for outdoor enthusiasts. This robust survival knife features a durable stainless steel blade measuring 7 1/2 inches, designed to handle the toughest tasks. What sets the Ramster apart is its hollow steel handle, which contains essential survival items such as a compass and fishing hooks, providing you with critical tools in the palm of your hand. The camping knife comes with a nylon and plastic sheath that includes pouches and sharpening stones, ensuring your blade stays sharp.
